experiment.name: raw-semantics-matched-panorama-graph-plus-model-multirepo-diagnosis
limitations: Gold is programmatic controlled-fault truth, not natural production-incident annotation.
Raw and Panorama are two representations of the same executed oracle trace.

Raw-semantic preserves the raw record structure while supplying the same named lifecycle, record-kind, and evidence-grade semantics exposed by Panorama; it isolates structure from semantic scaffolding only within this prompt contract.
Graph-plus-model exposes a correct deterministic candidate; it tests interface preservation, not independent discovery.
All model conclusions remain Inferred even when exact.

gate.name: all requested calls complete with ID-valid citations and causal safety
